graph.title: LEGO City 7630 Front-End Loader
notes: The two separate groups are intentional. The booklet builds the loader (steps 1-25) and, separately on page 3, a standalone orange workman minifig (legs, torso, head, hard hat). Nothing in the booklet attaches the minifig to the loader; the cover just shows him standing beside it. His four parts are joined to each other and kept as their own group.
Stickers (7630 logos, red/white hazard stripes) are not parts and are omitted.
Piece ids come from the inventory page. Ambiguous steps (e.g. page 3 step 3, where the picture shows a yellow plate but the fork plate 4265486 appears in step 4) were interpreted.
The red steering wheel on a plate (inventory 9552) is mapped to the catalogue's lego-steering-wheel-on-plate, since 9552 is not a standard element number.

Exact stacking of the dark and yellow deck plates (steps 9-15) is best-effort, as is where the second ladder, the two black 1x3 plates (4211133), and the third dark 1x4 tile attach. The bumper is attached to the rear plate b60. Every inventory piece is used the stated number of times.

Where a stud or anti-stud port already carried one connection, additional connections on that part leave the port null, because each stud can hold only one join. Plates that span two parts use the second port or null.

The 4121715 pins are modelled as double-ended pins: two sit in the holed 1x2 bricks (upper arm pivots), two in the bucket-mount plate (lower arm pivots). The 370526 axle runs through the arms' elbow holes.

The 408526 clip plates are given a hinge port so they can clip onto the finger plates on the cab roof; the yellow half bushes (4239601) sit on them. The 3005744 pieces are the two yellow rings on the axle in step 22. 614126 (black round pieces, step 19) is joined with null ports.
Wheels are the tyre 4506553 and rim 4490142 on the four pins of the two 4509884 axle plates (rear b7, front b14). The windscreen halves (4543458) and the roof are joined to the body at step 24.

graph_initial.title: LEGO City 7630 Front-End Loader
notes: Stickers (7630 logos, red/white hazard stripes) are not parts and are omitted.

Piece ids come from the inventory page. Colours come from the pictures. Ambiguous steps (e.g. step 3 on page 3, where the picture shows a yellow plate but the fork plate 4265486 appears in step 4) were interpreted.

The exact stacking of the dark and yellow deck plates (steps 9-15) and where the second ladder, the two 1x3 black plates (4211133) and the third 1x4 dark tile attach are best-effort guesses, but every inventory piece is used the stated number of times.

The 4121715 pins are modelled as double-ended pins. Two sit in the 1x2 holed bricks (upper arm pivots). Two sit in the bucket-mount plate (lower arm pivots). The arms' elbow holes carry the 370526 axle.
The 408526 clip plates carry the yellow half bushes (4239601) on the cab roof finger plates. The 3005744 pieces are the two yellow rings on the axle in step 22.
Wheels (tyre 4506553 + rim 4490142) go on the four pins of the two 4509884 axle plates (rear b7, front b14). Windscreen halves (4543458) and the roof are joined to the body at step 24.
Parts not in the catalogue were added as new types with best-guess ports. 614126 is used as the black round pieces of step 19 (catalogue entry has only a pin-hole port).
Catalogue port names for 302024 and 300124 (top.1 / bottom.1) were used; the minifig is built on page 3 and is not attached to the loader.

final_issue_list: the build is 2 separate groups of pieces; connect them unless the booklet really builds separate models
